title: The 12th Meeting of the Community and Protective Services Committee

content.string: The meeting was called to order at 4:00 PM; it being noted that the following Members were in remote attendance: Councillors M. Mamou, J. Helmer and S. Hillier.

That it BE NOTED that Councillor S. Hillier disclosed a pecuniary interest in clause 5.1 of this Report, having to do with the Deferred Matters List, specifically item number 1 on the list, by indicating that his family hosts a five day event.

1.title: Update on the Roadmap to 3,000 Affordable Units

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Deputy City Manager, Planning and Economic Development, the staff report, dated November 1, 2022, with respect to an update on the Roadmap to 3,000 Affordable Units, BE RECEIVED. (2022-D04)

attachments.title: 2022-11-01 SR - Update on the Roadmap to 3,000 Affordable Units

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Deputy City Manager, Enterprise Supports, the following actions be taken with respect to the staff report, dated November 1, 2022, related to the 2022 Annual Emergency Management Program Update:

a)    the proposed by-law, as appended to the above-noted staff report, BE INTRODUCED at the Municipal Council meeting to be held on November 8, 2022 to:

i)    repeal and replace Schedule “A”, being the City of London Emergency Response Plan, as appended to the above-noted staff report; and,

ii)    repeal By-law No. A.-7657(d)-367; and,
b)    the above-noted staff report BE RECEIVED. (2022-P03)

attachments.title: 2022-11-01 SR - 2022 Annual Emergency Management Program Update - Full

3.title: Former River Road Golf Course - Plans for Ownership and Municipal Use

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Deputy City Manager, Environmental and Infrastructure and the Deputy City Manager, Finance Supports, on the advice of the Director, Parks and Forestry and the Director, Realty Services, the staff report, dated November 1, 2022, with respect to Plans for Ownership and Municipal Use related to the Former River Road Golf Course, BE RECEIVED; it being noted that the communications, as appended to the Added Agenda, from Councillor M. van Holst, S. Watson, A. McGuigan and A. Johnson, with respect to this matter, were received. (2022-R05D)

attachments.title: 2022-11-01 SR - Former River Road Golf Course - Plans for Ownership and Municipal Use
